notes.title: Conquer our new lvl 75 Daily Dungeon
notes.content:
[h2]We've added a daily challenge dungeon![/h2]
Along with tons of other content, we've added a daily challenge dungeon to Worldseekers. Can you defeat the highest level instance?? Share a screenshot or I won't believe you ^__^ 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069987/c77e3e90b2da9deaf5ecdbb61743831deab8c44c.png[/img]

[h2]More items and more stories[/h2]
We've added a ton of new content, new narrative events, new monsters, and more is coming! We also have some special rewards for people who find all the items in the demo!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069987/f1620ceca12f25c6e8c84142e7bab57e6bea7443.png[/img]

[h2]Updated the main quest progress[/h2]
Can you defeat the masters? We've updated the main quest to show you your progress at each step! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069987/fc0827d0e9ee97485eab95a11f33cc35ab38e937.png[/img]

[h2]We're trying to go pro[/h2]
We're heading to GDC this year to tell folks about Worldseekers and some of the awesome stuff we think we can do with the game (with more time and money). So we're going to ask for investment / publication and more! So if you know of anyone or just want to cheer us on, drop me an email at jeff@worldseekersgame.com !
